artworks.title: Argus Building the Ship Argo
artworks.description: Victorian illustration titled for Argus at work on the Argo — Athena's pupil shaping the fifty-oared hull. Not Argus Panoptes, the hundred-eyed guard of Io.

artworks.title: The Building of the Ship Argo
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum painting of the Argo under construction — the ship Argus son of Arestor builds with Athena's craft.

artworks.title: Building the Argo
artworks.description: British Museum terracotta: Athena oversees the Argo's building — Argus' yard as Roman relief, the speaking timber still to come.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's peplum keeps the Argo as the voyage's star — Argus' hull carrying Jason to Colchis under Athena's eye.

films.title: The Giants of Thessaly
films.description: Freda's Italian Argonaut film restages the ship's adventure — the vessel Argus built still the engine of the quest.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius makes Argus son of Arestor the builder Athena guides — Dodona timber in the prow, distinct from Argus son of Phrixus at Colchis.

popCulture.title: Argus (Argonaut)
popCulture.description: Builder of the Argo — not Argus Panoptes, not the eponymous king of Argos, not Phrixus' Colchian son.
